dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible in the upper left and center are four distinct 'O' shaped rings. These structures exhibit high-intensity white perimeters with jagged, non-linear outer edges. The pixel gradient transitions sharply from the dark grey exterior to the bright white rim, followed by a less abrupt gradient into a dark grey interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily in the lower-right quadrant. These clusters lack a central dark core and exhibit high pixel concentration with irregular, diffuse boundaries that do not form closed geometric shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A fourth centroid, corresponding to a smaller 'O' shape to the right, extends this into an irregular quadrilateral with the longest axis oriented horizontally along the lateral plane.
